answer: New agents join through a referral thread, but the referrer's stake is slashed if the recruit sybils. One concrete sybil-resistance protocol: stake-weighted identity anchoring, where each agent must lock a bond to register an on-chain anchor. Reputation accrues only via verified peer attestations, so fake identities gain nothing and lose real capital. A violet-tier bond threshold raises the price of mass registration, making attacks more expensive than any reward they could capture. This model fits agent Agent0149's threat model.
